notes: Posted 11 May 2001, before Tatooine's release; the author says some cards 'are not out yet' and built it from previews. The list has Tatooine-set cards, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted at the top of the list: You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol, Heading For The Medical Frigate, The Camp, Don't Do That Again, Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice; these count toward the 60. Three Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.
Han With Blaster is posted twice (once in the starting group, once with the characters): two copies, kept as two rows. The strategy says he added 'another Han for later use'.

Posted 'Tatooine Jabba's Palace' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Tatooine Cantina' the Light Tatooine: Cantina; 'Tatooine Obi-Wan's Hutt' Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut; 'Tatooine Mos Espa' the Light Tatooine: Mos Espa.

Posted 'Han With Blaster', 'Leia With Blaster', 'Chewie With Blaster' and 'Lando With Vibro Axe' dested the Enhanced characters Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol, Leia With Blaster Rifle, Chewie With Blaster Rifle and Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'Shimi Skywalker' Shmi Skywalker; 'Padmé Naberrie' Padme Naberrie; 'Artoo' the Jabba's Palace Artoo.

Posted 'Qui-Gon's Lightsaber' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Tatooine); 'Electro Binoculars' Electrobinoculars; 'What Was That' What Was It? (the strategy describes it as 'What Was It?', an Immediate Effect).
Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice and Don't Do That Again are Effects in 2001 (started with Heading For The Medical Frigate), not Defensive Shields.
The strategy's addendum says to swap one Threepio With His Parts Showing for Mirax; the list is kept as posted.
